desc:
🎣 HOOKED! BETA

The game is still in Beta and you may experience bugs feedback would be greatly appreciated. 

What IS here is the fishing, and it isn't click-and-wait:

• Two rigs float a baited hook and read the bobber, or work a lure back with stop-and-go retrieves and rod twitches
• Depth matters let it sink or wind it steady, fish hold at different depths
• 16 species that fight differently bass jump and throw the hook, catfish sound for the bottom
• Play the fish properly: drag, line tension, and tells you have to read
• Boats that actually sit in the water
